capabilities: Show heading sections as left-to-right card columns
Edit card title and body inline
Reorder and reparent cards by drag and drop
Edit YAML properties and intro prose in a header panel
Apply theme or custom palette colors and fold branches
disambiguation: Not a fractal or math image generator; it lays out a note's headings as a card tree.
extras: Makes no network requests and collects no telemetry; visual preferences are stored in the plugin's data.json. Works on desktop and mobile without Node.js or Electron.
motivation: Long Markdown documents force a choice between keeping high-level structure in view and focusing on paragraph-level writing.
problem: Long Markdown notes make it hard to keep the high-level heading structure in view while writing at paragraph level.
summary: Card-tree view that turns a note's Markdown heading hierarchy into columns of editable cards.
